6373.title: RPC validation diagnostics omit structured field paths
6373.rootCauseOneLine: The boundary Error message contains only the generic RPC summary, and invokeWrapped logs that message rather than the preserved structured issue paths.
6373.proposedFix: Append bounded, JSON-escaped normalized issue paths to the internal boundary Error message without changing the HTTP error or forwarding arbitrary validation messages or values.
6373.caveats: Pinned current main only; same-agent second clean reproduction. Custom schema messages are not safe to log verbatim. No packaged-release or production-instance test.
